# `@videojs/spf/behaviors/dom/track-load-triggers`

Source: [src/playback/behaviors/dom/track-load-triggers.ts](../../../../src/playback/behaviors/dom/track-load-triggers.ts)

## trackLoadTriggers

Track preload-overriding events per source.

Writes `state.loadActivated = true` the first time a `play` or `seeking` event fires on the attached media element
for the current source — or immediately on entry if the element is already committed to loading (`el.autoplay`,
`!el.paused`, or `el.seeking`), covering autoplay, native-controls, and direct-DOM-`play()` scenarios.

Sticky-true _within a source identity_: subsequent play/pause/seek cycles don't flip back. Source identity =
(mediaElement, presentation URL). Either changing — including direct in-place swap with no `undefined` intermediate —
resets the slot to `false`.

Multi-writer with `hls/adapter.ts:play()` (which writes `true` directly on programmatic play) is intentional —
different domains. The adapter records programmatic intent; this behavior is the DOM-side observer. Pre-existing
`true` writes are honored because `deriveState` reads the slot — a `true` value routes directly to `'load-active'`
without entering `'monitoring'`.

```ts
const reactor = trackLoadTriggers.setup({ state, context });
// later:
reactor.destroy();
```

Source: [src/playback/behaviors/dom/track-load-triggers.ts](../../../../src/playback/behaviors/dom/track-load-triggers.ts)

### Config

The setup declares `config?`: callers may omit it. It has no keys.

### State

| Key | Access | Declared | Type | Owner | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loadActivated` | writes | yes | `boolean \| undefined` | `LoadTriggersState` | Sticky-true per source. Flips to `true` the first time an event occurs that should switch loading behavior from preload-based to standard load (currently DOM `play` / `seeking`). Reset to `false` on source change. Read by `resolvePresentation` and `loadVideoSegments` / `loadAudioSegments` to mirror native `HTMLMediaElement` preload semantics — only meaningful when `preload !== 'auto'`, which already loads fully regardless. |
| `presentation` | reads | yes | `MaybeResolvedPresentation \| undefined` | `LoadTriggersState` | Current presentation — URL is used to detect source changes. |

### Context

| Key | Access | Declared | Type | Owner | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mediaElement` | reads | yes | `HTMLMediaElement \| undefined` | `LoadTriggersContext` | The media element the engine drives. No behavior writes it: the host attaches one with `engine.context.mediaElement.set(element)` and detaches with `set(undefined)`, as the SPF Medias do. (documented on [setupMediaSource](setup-mediasource.md#setupmediasource)) |
